definitions.explanation: A polite term to refer to another person's wife.

examples.japanese: {奥|おく}さんは{元気|げんき}ですか。
{田中|たなか}さんの{奥|おく}さん
{奥|おく}さんによろしくお{伝|つた}えください。
examples.english: Please give my regards to your wife.

notes:
{奥|おく}さん is used to refer to someone else's wife.

WIFE TERMS:
- {奥|おく}さん: (someone else's) wife (polite)
- {妻|つま}: my wife (humble)
- {家内|かない}: my wife (humble, traditional)
- かみさん: wife (casual)

NOTE: Don't use {奥|おく}さん for your own wife when speaking to others.
